newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cycle & Carriage names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Cycle & Carriage names new chairman.

text.p: Car retailer Cycle & Carriage said on Tuesday Yahaya bin Ahmad had been elected chairman of the company with immediate effect.
Yahaya joined the company's board in January 1996 and holds a professional qualification in automotive engineering, a company statement said.
He is chairman of several Malaysian listed companies and is controlling shareholder in Malaysian national car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) and Diversified Resources Berhad.
He replaces Paduka Sallehuddin bin Mohamed, who remains a company director. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
